1:
<sp(0)>This is an investigative report
concerning the military satellite
#c[BE5050]Guardian#c.
2:
<sp(0)>Here we summarize new findings from the
#c[5E8FD8]UCE Design Bureau#c, combined with
previous investigation results.
3:
<sp(0)>First, among previously known #c[BE5050]satellite#c
functions is long-range artillery operated
by the #c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c.<im(1)>
4:
<sp(0)>This capability allows high-output
bombardment <im(2)>of the level previously seen
during Operation Stardust.
5:
<sp(0)>Furthermore, it has been revealed that the
military satellite #c[BE5050]Guardian#c is fitted with
a mechanism to yield even greater output.
6:
<sp(0)>This attack function is realized by
simultaneously activating multiple
#c[BE5050]Guardians#c.
7:
<sp(0)>#c[BE5050]Guardian#c control incorporates an inter-
satellite data-link system, designed to
enable simultaneous multi-unit operation.
8:
<sp(0)>In other words, this indicates that
simultaneous bombardment from multiple
military satellites is possible.
9:
<sp(0)>Using hundreds of #c[BE5050]Guardians#c could yield
an ultra-output strike able to destroy
even a colony-scale mass.
10:
<sp(0)>The following is a hypothesis based upon
these findings.
11:
<sp(0)>Telemetry gathered so far indicates that
firing accuracy and output control during
satellite strikes were still imperfect.
12:
<sp(0)>Thus, #c[BE5050]Rainen#c may be repeatedly mounting
raids across various regions <im(3)>in order
to calibrate these discrepancies.
13:
<sp(0)>Indeed, data confirms that every time the
#c[BE5050]Buster Ark#c appears, this performance and
output have shown steady improvement.
14:
<sp(0)>Assuming this hypothesis holds true...
#c[BE5050]Rainen#c would establish military strength
independent of conventional manpower.
15:
<sp(0)>How he will use this cannot be foreseen,
but there is no doubt that the #c[BE5050]Guardian#c
poses an immense and grave danger.
